errors.kimiAgentChangeOnResume: Kimi cannot change the agent when resuming a session. Remove the agent override or start a new session in the generation recipe or CLI arguments.
errors.kimiAgentOptionsConflict: Kimi received conflicting or repeated agent options. Keep a single --agent or --agent-file option in the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiAuthFailed: Kimi could not authenticate. Sign in or correct provider credentials on the execution host, then retry.
errors.kimiCancelled: Kimi cancelled the request before it finished generating text. Try again.
errors.kimiConfigInvalid: Kimi has invalid configuration. Check the model and provider configuration on the execution host before retrying.
errors.kimiConflictingOptions: Kimi received conflicting options: {{option}} with {{otherOption}}. Correct the generation recipe or CLI arguments before retrying.
errors.kimiConnectionFailed: Kimi could not connect to its provider. Check the network on the execution host, then retry.
errors.kimiContextOverflow: Kimi ran out of context. Shorten the prompt or start a new session, then retry.
errors.kimiContinueSessionConflict: Kimi received conflicting options: --continue, --session. Correct the generation recipe or CLI arguments before retrying.
errors.kimiCredentialVariableMissing: Kimi is missing a configured credential environment variable. Set it on the execution host before retrying.
errors.kimiCredentialsRequired: Kimi needs provider credentials. Open Kimi on the execution host to configure a provider or sign in, then retry.
errors.kimiEmptyAgent: Kimi received an empty agent. Correct that input in the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiEmptyAgentFilePath: Kimi received an empty agent file path. Correct that input in the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiEmptyModel: Kimi received an empty model. Correct that input in the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiEmptyPrompt: Kimi received an empty prompt. Correct that input in the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiFailed: Kimi couldn't finish generating text. Open Kimi on the execution host to check the failure before retrying.
errors.kimiInterrupted: Kimi was interrupted before it finished generating text. Try again.
errors.kimiModelMissing: Kimi has no usable model configured. Open Kimi on the execution host to configure or select a model, then retry.
errors.kimiOptionRejected: Kimi rejected an option or argument. Correct the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiOutputFormatInvalid: Kimi output format requires prompt mode and a supported text or stream-json value. Correct the generation recipe or CLI arguments before retrying.
errors.kimiPromptHookBlocked: A Kimi prompt hook blocked the request or the turn couldn't start. Review Kimi hooks and configuration before retrying.
errors.kimiProviderLimited: Kimi reached a provider limit or the provider is busy. Wait before retrying or reduce request frequency.
errors.kimiResponseBlocked: Kimi could not return a response because it was blocked. Revise the prompt or model configuration before retrying.
errors.kimiSessionIdRequired: Kimi needs a session id to resume in prompt mode. Correct the generation recipe or CLI arguments, then retry.
errors.kimiSessionNotFound: Kimi couldn't find the requested session. Use an existing session or start a new one.
errors.kimiSessionOccupied: Kimi couldn't use this session because it is active in another client. Stop the session there or exit that client, then try again.
errors.kimiSessionOtherDirectory: This Kimi session belongs to another directory. Resume it there or use a session created for this workspace.
errors.kimiUnreadableOutput: Kimi returned output Orca couldn't read. Try again.

errors.promptTooLargeForArgument: {{label}} prompt is too large to pass as a single command-line argument. Stage fewer changes and try again.
errors.promptTooLargeForWindows: {{label}} prompt is too large for the Windows command line. Stage fewer changes and try again.

errors.sourceControlCustomCommandEmpty: Custom command is empty. Add one in Settings -> Git -> Source Control AI.
errors.windowsBatchUnsafeArguments: {{label}} runs through a Windows batch script that cannot take the multi-line prompt as an argument. Point Settings at the agent's executable, or use a custom command without {prompt} so Orca sends the prompt on stdin.
